textNodes.text: Maison Rouge sells lipstick in 40 shades and their customers kept ordering the wrong one. The packaging was beautiful, the online choice was guesswork.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: The job: new packaging that makes the shade obvious, and a 3D configurator that lets people see the case and the colour together before they buy.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Audited returns with the customer team to find which shades caused the most mistakes
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Designed a packaging system where the shade is printed on the cap, not hidden underneath
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Modelled the case in Blender and built a lightweight 3D viewer for the web
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Tested the configurator with twelve customers on their own phones
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Handed over the 3D files and viewer code to the agency running the shop
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif

textNodes.text: Same hands on both sides. The frame on the left is the design file, the panel on the right is what shipped — type, spacing and colour come straight across.
textNodes.fontFamily: "Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
"Mona Sans Variable", "Mona Sans Variable Placeholder", sans-serif
